create_BlenderCameraDataSource: create a BlenderCameraDataSource instance that loads camera poses and bounds from a Blender scene JSON file
parse_BlenderCameraDataSource_poses: parse transform matrices from a Blender scene JSON into a stacked numpy array of camera poses
compute_BlenderCameraDataSource_focal: compute the camera focal length from the Blender scene FOV and image height and width
register_BlenderCameraDataSource: register the BlenderCameraDataSource class under the name blender_camera for use as a data source
extract_BlenderCameraDataSource_bounds: extract per-frame near and far clipping plane bounds from a Blender scene JSON with fallback defaults
